brief: Upbeat indie pop, a little proud, a little scared.
title: Four White Walls
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Boxes in the hallway, tape around my hands,
a mattress on the floor and no real plans,
the faucet makes a sound like it's alive,
I eat my cereal at half past five.

[Chorus]
Four white walls and a key of my own,
nobody calling me back home,
four white walls and a window on the street,
it's small, it's mine, it's incomplete.

[Verse 2]
I hang a picture slightly to the left,
I learn which stair will creak beneath my step,
the neighbours play guitar at two a.m.,
and I start singing quietly with them.

[Chorus]
Four white walls and a key of my own,
nobody calling me back home,
four white walls and a window on the street,
it's small, it's mine, it's incomplete.
reason: On topic, natural English, steady meter, clear repeated hook.
